title: The Book of Colossians Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Colossians — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
verses.decoded: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ appointed by God's will, and Timothy, our brother,

verses.kjv: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: To the holy and faithful brothers and sisters in Christ at Colossae: May you receive grace and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.decoded: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, and we continually pray for you,

verses.kjv: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
verses.decoded: Because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all God's people,

verses.kjv: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
verses.decoded: The hope that is stored up for you in heaven, which you heard about before through the true message of the gospel;

verses.kjv: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
verses.decoded: This gospel has come to you just as it has to the whole world, and it is producing fruit and growing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood God's grace.

verses.kjv: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
verses.decoded: You learned it from Epaphras, our dear coworker, who faithfully serves Christ on your behalf;

verses.kjv: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
verses.decoded: He also told us about the love you have in the Spirit.

verses.kjv: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
verses.decoded: For this reason, since we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you. We ask that you may be filled with the knowledge of God's will through all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

verses.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.decoded: So that you may live in a way that pleases the Lord, bearing fruit in every good work and growing in your knowledge of God.

verses.kjv: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
verses.decoded: Being strengthened with all power according to his glorious might, so that you may have great endurance and patience, and be joyful,

verses.kjv: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
verses.decoded: Giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the kingdom of light.

verses.kjv: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
verses.decoded: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of his beloved Son,

verses.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
verses.decoded: In whom we have redemption—the forgiveness of sins—through his blood,

verses.kjv: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
verses.decoded: Who is the visible image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation,

verses.kjv: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
verses.decoded: Everything in heaven and on earth, whether seen or unseen—such as thrones, rulers, authorities, and powers—was created by him and for him.

verses.kjv: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
verses.decoded: He existed before everything else, and everything continues to exist because of him.

verses.kjv: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verses.decoded: He is the leader of the church, which is his body. He is the first to rise from the dead, so that he might have the highest honor in everything.

verses.kjv: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
verses.decoded: The Father was pleased to have all his fullness live in him.

verses.kjv: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
verses.decoded: Through the blood of his cross, he made peace and reconciled everything to himself—things on earth and in heaven.

verses.kjv: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
verses.decoded: You were once separated and hostile in your thoughts because of your evil actions, but now he has brought you back to himself.

verses.kjv: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
verses.decoded: He did this through his physical death to present you as holy, blameless, and faultless before him.

verses.kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
verses.decoded: If you remain firmly established in your faith and don’t lose the hope of the gospel you heard—which has been preached to everyone under heaven—of which I, Paul, am a servant;

verses.kjv: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
verses.decoded: I now rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, completing in my body what is still lacking in Christ’s afflictions for the sake of his church.

verses.kjv: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
verses.decoded: I have been appointed as a servant of this ministry by God’s plan, given to me for your benefit, to fully proclaim God’s message.

verses.kjv: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
verses.decoded: This mystery was hidden for ages and generations but has now been revealed to God’s holy people.

verses.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
verses.decoded: God wanted them to know the incredible glory of this mystery among the Gentiles: that Christ lives in you, giving you hope for glory.

verses.kjv: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
verses.decoded: We preach Christ, warning and teaching everyone with all wisdom so that we may present everyone mature in Christ.

verses.kjv: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
verses.decoded: I work hard at this, relying on the power of Christ working strongly within me.

verses.kjv: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.decoded: I want you to understand how much I struggle and care deeply for you, for the believers in Laodicea, and for all who have never met me in person.

verses.kjv: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
verses.decoded: I pray that their hearts will be encouraged and united in love, fully assured and deeply understanding the mystery of God, the Father, and Christ.

verses.kjv: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.decoded: In Christ are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.kjv: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
verses.decoded: I say this so that no one can deceive you with clever arguments.

verses.kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.decoded: Even though I am not physically with you, I am with you in spirit, rejoicing to see your good discipline and strong faith in Christ.

verses.kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
verses.decoded: Since you have accepted Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him.

verses.kjv: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
verses.decoded: Be firmly rooted and built up in Christ, strengthened in your faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

verses.kjv: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
verses.decoded: Be careful not to let anyone deceive you with empty philosophy based on human traditions and worldly principles, rather than on Christ.

verses.kjv: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
verses.decoded: For the complete nature of God lives in Christ in a human body.

verses.kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
verses.decoded: And you are made complete in Christ, who is the supreme leader over all rulers and authorities.

verses.kjv: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
verses.decoded: In him you were spiritually circumcised—not by human hands but by Christ—removing the sinful nature of your flesh.

verses.kjv: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
verses.decoded: You were buried with Christ through baptism, and just as God raised him from the dead, you also have been raised to new life through your faith in God’s power.

verses.kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
verses.decoded: Even though you were spiritually dead because of your sins and sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ and forgave all your sins.

verses.kjv: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verses.decoded: He canceled the written laws that were against us, which opposed us, by nailing them to the cross.

verses.kjv: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.decoded: Christ defeated the spiritual rulers and authorities, publicly showing his victory over them through the cross.

verses.kjv: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
verses.decoded: So don’t let anyone criticize you for what you eat or drink, or for observing special days like festivals, new moons, or Sabbaths.

verses.kjv: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
verses.decoded: These things are only a shadow pointing to what is coming, but the reality belongs to Christ.

verses.kjv: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.decoded: Don’t let anyone cheat you out of your reward by promoting false humility and worship of angels, getting involved in things they haven’t seen, and becoming proud because of their sinful human thinking.

verses.kjv: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
verses.decoded: They are not connected to the Head—Christ—from whom the whole body grows and is held together by every joint and ligament, receiving nourishment and growing as God causes it to grow.

verses.kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
verses.decoded: Since you died with Christ to the basic principles of this world, why do you still live as if you must follow its rules?

verses.kjv: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
verses.decoded: (Don’t touch, don’t taste, don’t handle;

verses.kjv: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
verses.decoded: all of which are destined to perish when used, based on human commands and teachings?

verses.kjv: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
verses.decoded: These rules may seem wise because they promote self-imposed worship, humility, and harsh treatment of the body, but they don’t actually help control sinful desires.

verses.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
verses.decoded: Since you have been raised with Christ, focus on the things above, where Christ is seated at God's right hand.

verses.kjv: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.decoded: Keep your thoughts and desires on heavenly things, not on earthly things.

verses.kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
verses.decoded: You have died to your old self, and your true life is hidden with Christ in God.

verses.kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
verses.decoded: When Christ, who is our life, appears, you will also appear with him in glory.

verses.kjv: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
verses.decoded: So put to death the earthly parts of your life: sexual immorality, impurity, uncontrolled desires, evil cravings, and greed, which is idolatry.

verses.kjv: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
verses.decoded: Because of these sins, God's anger comes on those who disobey him.

verses.kjv: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
verses.decoded: You used to live that way when you followed those sins.

verses.kjv: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
verses.decoded: But now, get rid of all these things: anger, rage, evil intentions, slander, and dirty language.

verses.kjv: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
verses.decoded: Don't lie to each other because you have taken off your old self with its sinful ways.

verses.kjv: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
verses.decoded: Instead, put on the new self, which is being renewed to become like the image of its Creator.

verses.kjv: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.decoded: Here there is no distinction between Greek or Jew, circumcised or not, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free—for Christ is everything and is in everyone.

verses.kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.decoded: So, as God's chosen people who are holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

verses.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
verses.decoded: Be patient with each other and forgive anyone who has a complaint against you, just as Christ forgave you.

verses.kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
verses.decoded: Above all, put on love, which binds everything together in perfect unity.

verses.kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
verses.decoded: Let God's peace control your hearts, since you were called to live together as one body. Always be thankful.

verses.kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.decoded: Let the message of Christ live in you fully, teaching and encouraging each other with songs, hymns, and spiritual music, singing with thankfulness in your hearts to God.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verses.decoded: Whatever you say or do, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, always giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

verses.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
verses.decoded: Wives, respect and support your own husbands as is appropriate in the Lord.

verses.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
verses.decoded: Husbands, love your wives and do not treat them harshly or with anger.

verses.kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: Children, obey your parents in everything because this pleases the Lord.

verses.kjv: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
verses.decoded: Fathers, do not make your children angry or upset, so they don’t lose heart.

verses.kjv: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
verses.decoded: Servants, obey your earthly masters in everything, not just when being watched to please people, but sincerely, with reverence for God.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.decoded: Whatever you do, do it enthusiastically, as if you are doing it for the Lord and not just for people.

verses.kjv: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
verses.decoded: Remember that you will receive your reward from the Lord, because you are serving Christ the Lord.

verses.kjv: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
verses.decoded: Anyone who does wrong will be punished for it, and God shows no favoritism.

verses.kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
verses.decoded: Masters, treat your servants fairly and justly, remembering that you also have a Master in heaven.

verses.kjv: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verses.decoded: Keep praying and stay alert in your prayers, always giving thanks.

verses.kjv: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
verses.decoded: Also pray for us, that God will give us opportunities to clearly share the message of Christ, which I am imprisoned for.

verses.kjv: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.decoded: So that I can explain it clearly and properly.

verses.kjv: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
verses.decoded: Live wisely when dealing with those outside the faith, making the most of every opportunity.

verses.kjv: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
verses.decoded: Always speak kindly and thoughtfully, making your words interesting and wise, so you know how to respond to everyone.

verses.kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
verses.decoded: Tychicus, a dear brother and faithful servant of the Lord, will tell you everything about my situation.

verses.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
verses.decoded: I have sent him to you to find out how you are doing and to encourage you.

verses.kjv: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
verses.decoded: Along with Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother who is one of you, they will tell you everything happening here.

verses.kjv: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
verses.decoded: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, sends greetings, as does Mark, Barnabas’s nephew. You were told to welcome him if he comes to you.

verses.kjv: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
verses.decoded: Jesus, also called Justus, who is a Jewish believer, sends greetings. These are the only coworkers of mine for God’s kingdom who have been a comfort to me.

verses.kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
verses.decoded: Epaphras, one of you and a servant of Christ, sends greetings. He is always working hard in prayer for you, asking that you may stand strong and fully obey God’s will.

verses.kjv: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
verses.decoded: I can testify that he has great passion for you, and also for the believers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.

verses.kjv: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
verses.decoded: Luke, the dear doctor, and Demas send you greetings.

verses.kjv: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
verses.decoded: Give my greetings to the believers in Laodicea, to Nymphas, and to the church that meets in his home.

verses.kjv: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
verses.decoded: When this letter is read among you, make sure it is also read in the church at Laodicea, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

verses.kjv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
verses.decoded: Tell Archippus to be careful and fully commit to the ministry God has given him.

verses.kjv: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.decoded: This greeting is from me, Paul. Remember that I am in prison. May God's grace be with you. Amen.
